"RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

MASTER GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT

Complete 3D Anime Dark Fantasy Idle RPG for Android

Create a completely new, original, high-quality 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG called:

RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

This is a single-player mobile RPG designed for Android.

The game combines autonomous combat, dungeon exploration, character progression, equipment collection, class evolution, companions, powerful bosses and a premium currency economy.

The game should have a visual identity inspired by high-quality realistic 3D dark fantasy anime, with cinematic character models, detailed environments, realistic lighting and spectacular combat effects.

Use modern dark fantasy anime games as visual inspiration, but create original characters, creatures, environments, names and storylines.

IMPORTANT:
Build an actual playable game, not just a collection of menus, concept art or static interfaces.

---

1. GAME IDENTITY

Game title: RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

Genre:

- Idle RPG.
- Dark fantasy.
- Dungeon crawler.
- Character progression.
- Automatic combat.
- Equipment collection.
- Companion collection.

Platform: Android mobile.

Gameplay perspective: Third person.

Game mode: Single-player.

The game must be designed primarily for touchscreen devices.

The player controls character development, equipment, abilities, classes, companions and dungeon selection.

The character fights and explores automatically.

There must be no requirement for manual joystick movement.

---

2. GRAPHICS AND ART DIRECTION

Create a premium realistic 3D anime visual style.

Visual requirements:

- Detailed human-like character models.
- Realistic anime faces and expressions.
- Detailed hairstyles.
- High-quality clothing and armor.
- Realistic materials and textures.
- Cinematic lighting.
- Dynamic shadows.
- Magical energy effects.
- Detailed monsters.
- Spectacular boss animations.
- Smooth combat animations.
- Atmospheric dungeon environments.

Visual inspiration:
Modern realistic 3D dark fantasy anime.

The game should feel like a premium anime action RPG.

Use dark environments with blue, cyan, purple, red and golden magical effects.

Optimize graphics for Android mobile devices without sacrificing visual quality unnecessarily.

---

3. STORY AND WORLD

Create an original fantasy universe.

The world is threatened by mysterious dimensional portals called Gates.

These Gates lead to dangerous dungeons inhabited by monsters, demons and ancient creatures.

Humans capable of fighting these creatures are known as Hunters.

Hunters are classified according to their power.

The player begins as an unknown and extremely weak Rank F Hunter.

Through dungeon exploration, combat, special missions and awakening events, the player gradually becomes one of the most powerful hunters in existence.

Create an original main storyline with:

- Hunter organizations.
- Mysterious Gates.
- Ancient civilizations.
- Powerful dungeon bosses.
- Secret missions.
- Special awakening events.
- Hidden legendary powers.

The story must be expandable through future updates.

---

4. IDLE GAMEPLAY AND AUTOMATIC COMBAT

The core gameplay must be an autonomous idle RPG.

The player character must:

- Move automatically through dungeon environments.
- Detect nearby enemies.
- Select targets automatically.
- Approach enemies.
- Attack automatically.
- Use basic combat animations.
- Select another enemy after defeating the current target.
- Collect rewards automatically.
- Progress through dungeon encounters.

Enemies must:

- Attack the player.
- Have individual health and damage.
- Use different attack patterns.
- Have unique animations.
- Become progressively stronger.

The player can die and respawn.

Create functional combat health bars and damage indicators.

The player must not need to manually control movement.

The player manually activates special abilities through touchscreen buttons.

---

5. MANUAL SKILL SYSTEM

Create four manually activated skill buttons.

Initial skills:

1. Powerful Strike.
2. Area Attack.
3. Healing.
4. Ultimate Ability.

Every skill must have:

- Unique animations.
- Visual effects.
- Damage or healing values.
- Cooldown timers.
- Upgrade levels.

Skills must be functional and responsive.

Add additional class-specific skills later.

---

6. CHARACTER PROGRESSION

Create a complete RPG character progression system.

Character attributes:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.

Combat statistics:

- Maximum Health.
- Attack Damage.
- Defense.
- Critical Chance.
- Critical Damage.
- Attack Speed.
- Movement Speed.
- Health Regeneration.
- Magical Damage.

The character must gain experience through:

- Defeating enemies.
- Completing dungeons.
- Defeating bosses.
- Completing quests.
- Achievements.

Include:

- Character levels.
- Experience bars.
- Attribute points.
- Skill points.
- Gold rewards.
- Character status screen.

Allow players to invest attribute points manually or use an optional automatic allocation system.

---

7. HUNTER RANK SYSTEM

Create nine separate character ranks.

F
E
D
C
B
A
S
SS
SSS

The character starts at Rank F.

Rank progression must require:

- Minimum character level.
- Special achievements.
- Rank examination missions.
- Powerful boss victories.
- Specific progression milestones.

Every rank must have:

- Unique emblem.
- Visual identity.
- Rank color.
- Rank progression screen.
- Unlockable rewards.
- Special requirements.

Rank progression must be separate from character class and equipment rarity.

A character can be:

- Warrior Rank S.
- Assassin Rank A.
- Mage Rank SSS.
- Necromancer Rank SS.

Do not combine rank and class into one progression system.

---

8. CHARACTER CLASS SYSTEM

The player starts as an unclassified Hunter.

Create four main classes.

WARRIOR:

Combat style:
Heavy physical damage and defense.

Class evolutions:

- Knight.
- Paladin.
- Warrior King.

ASSASSIN:

Combat style:
Fast attacks, critical damage and agility.

Class evolutions:

- Shadow.
- Reaper.
- Shadow Lord.

MAGE:

Combat style:
Elemental magic and area damage.

Class evolutions:

- Sorcerer.
- Archmage.
- Arcane Master.

NECROMANCER:

Combat style:
Dark magic and undead summoning.

Class evolutions:

- Summoner.
- Master of the Dead.
- Undead Sovereign.

Each class must have:

- Unique equipment.
- Unique abilities.
- Unique animations.
- Different attributes.
- Special class bonuses.
- Class-specific progression quests.

Allow switching between unlocked classes.

Class evolutions require levels, achievements and special missions.

---

9. AWAKENING SYSTEM

Create five character awakening stages.

1. Dormant.
2. Awakened.
3. Evolved.
4. Transcendent.
5. Sovereign.

Each stage requires:

- Specific character level.
- Special awakening quest.
- Dungeon challenges.
- Powerful boss encounters.
- Awakening materials.

Each awakening stage must provide:

- Improved attributes.
- New abilities.
- Visual character transformation.
- Magical aura.
- Glowing eyes.
- Energy particles.
- Unique effects.

Create a special awakening animation.

Class-specific abilities:

WARRIOR:

- Absolute Fury.
- Titan's Defense.

ASSASSIN:

- Shadow Step.
- Phantom Execution.

MAGE:

- Arcane Storm.
- Elemental Overload.

NECROMANCER:

- Army of the Dead.
- Soul Harvest.

---

10. TALENT TREE

Create six talent branches.

- Attack.
- Defense.
- Agility.
- Magic.
- Summoning.
- Critical Damage.

Players earn talent points through character progression.

Every branch must contain multiple unlockable talents.

Talents must have meaningful gameplay effects.

Allow players to reset talents using an appropriate in-game resource.

---

11. DUNGEON SYSTEM

The game must use dungeon-based progression.

Do not create an open world.

Create three initial dungeons:

FORGOTTEN CATACOMBS:

- Skeleton Warriors.
- Undead Creatures.
- Skeleton King boss.

ABANDONED MINES:

- Goblins.
- Cave Creatures.
- Goblin King boss.

DARK ABYSS:

- Demons.
- Shadow Creatures.
- Abyss Guardian boss.

Each dungeon must have:

- Multiple combat encounters.
- Increasing enemy difficulty.
- Unique environments.
- Boss encounters.
- Experience rewards.
- Gold rewards.
- Equipment drops.
- Special materials.

Defeating dungeon bosses unlocks new progression.

Include dungeon difficulty levels and replay functionality.

Start implementation with Forgotten Catacombs only.

Prepare the other dungeons for future expansion.

---

12. ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Create original monster designs.

Initial enemies:

- Skeleton Warrior.
- Goblin.
- Dark Creature.

Initial boss:

- Skeleton King.

Each enemy must have:

- Health.
- Damage.
- Defense.
- Attack animations.
- Experience rewards.
- Gold rewards.
- Equipment drop probabilities.

Bosses must have:

- Unique models.
- Special attacks.
- Multiple combat phases where appropriate.
- Boss health bars.
- Introductory animations.
- Exclusive loot tables.

Boss encounters should feel important and rewarding.

---

13. EQUIPMENT SYSTEM

Create a complete equipment system.

Equipment slots:

1. Weapon.
2. Helmet.
3. Chest Armor.
4. Gloves.
5. Boots.
6. Necklace.
7. Ring.
8. Artifact.

Weapon categories:

WARRIOR:

- Swords.
- Greatswords.
- Axes.
- Shields.

ASSASSIN:

- Daggers.
- Dual Blades.

MAGE:

- Magical Staffs.
- Wands.

NECROMANCER:

- Dark Staffs.
- Summoning Artifacts.

Equipment must have individual attributes.

---

14. EQUIPMENT RARITIES

Create eight equipment rarity levels.

1. Common — Gray.
2. Uncommon — Green.
3. Rare — Blue.
4. Epic — Purple.
5. Legendary — Orange.
6. Mythic — Red.
7. Divine — Gold.
8. Transcendent — Cyan.

Each rarity must have:

- Different visual borders.
- Different effects.
- Different attribute ranges.
- Different drop probabilities.
- Different item descriptions.

Higher rarity equipment can have more attributes and unique abilities.

Equipment rarity must be independent of character rank.

---

15. RANDOM EQUIPMENT ATTRIBUTES

Generate randomized item statistics.

Possible attributes:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.
- Attack Damage.
- Critical Chance.
- Critical Damage.
- Attack Speed.
- Defense.
- Health Regeneration.
- Life Steal.
- Magical Damage.

Legendary and higher rarity equipment can contain unique special effects.

Examples:

- Increased critical damage.
- Increased attack speed.
- Life steal.
- Increased magical damage.
- Summoning bonuses.
- Special combat abilities.

Every equipment drop must have a functional item description and statistics.

---

16. EQUIPMENT UPGRADING AND CRAFTING

Create an equipment upgrade system from +0 to +20.

Allow players to:

- Upgrade equipment.
- Use gold.
- Use upgrade materials.
- Craft equipment.
- Fuse duplicate items.
- Dismantle unwanted equipment.
- Compare items.
- Lock valuable equipment.
- Sell unwanted equipment.

Include upgrade animations and visual feedback.

Use reasonable failure protection.

Never unexpectedly destroy valuable equipment.

---

17. EQUIPMENT SETS

Create equipment sets.

Equipping multiple pieces from the same set activates bonuses.

Examples:

- Two-piece set bonus.
- Four-piece set bonus.
- Six-piece set bonus.

Create class-specific equipment sets.

Bosses should drop exclusive set pieces.

---

18. COMPANION SYSTEM

Create a companion collection and combat system.

Companion categories:

- Warrior.
- Assassin.
- Guardian.
- Mage.
- Creature.

Create original companions:

- Shadow Wolf.
- Spectral Knight.
- Aether Dragon.
- Ancient Golem.
- Soul Reaper.
- Celestial Guardian.

Each companion must have:

- Individual level.
- Experience.
- Health.
- Attack.
- Defense.
- Agility.
- Intelligence.
- Unique abilities.
- Evolution stages.

Companion rarities:

- Common.
- Rare.
- Epic.
- Legendary.
- Mythic.
- Divine.
- Transcendent.

Start with three active companion slots.

Allow players to unlock up to five slots through gameplay progression.

Companions must automatically participate in combat.

Include:

- Companion collection.
- Companion selection.
- Companion leveling.
- Companion evolution.
- Companion equipment.
- Companion skills.

---

19. CLASS-SPECIFIC SUMMONING

Create a special summoning system for Necromancers.

The Necromancer can convert eligible defeated enemies into shadow summons through special abilities and gameplay requirements.

Create:

- Shadow collection.
- Shadow levels.
- Shadow evolution.
- Shadow rarity.
- Shadow combat roles.
- Shadow upgrades.

The strongest shadows should require challenging gameplay achievements.

Other classes can use normal companions.

---

20. OFFLINE PROGRESSION

Implement offline progression.

The game must continue calculating simulated rewards when the player closes the application.

Record the last logout timestamp.

When the player returns:

- Calculate elapsed time.
- Calculate simulated combat rewards.
- Award experience.
- Award gold.
- Calculate eligible equipment drops.
- Display a summary of offline rewards.

Initial offline reward limit: 8 hours.

Allow VIP benefits to improve offline progression within a balanced limit.

Use persistent saving.

Protect offline rewards against timestamp manipulation and duplicate claims where possible through secure validation.

Offline progress must never require the application to remain open.

---

21. OFFICIAL PREMIUM CURRENCY: AETHER

Create the official premium currency called AETHER.

Visual identity:

- Electric blue.
- Cyan.
- Translucent crystal.
- White glowing energy.
- Magical particles.
- Premium dark fantasy appearance.

Create three visual forms:

AETHER SHARD:
Small crystal fragments.

AETHER CRYSTAL:
Main premium currency.

AETHER CORE:
Rare special artifact used for events and special content.

Aether Crystal is the official premium currency used in the shop.

Display the Aether balance in:

- Main interface.
- Character screen.
- Inventory.
- Shop.
- Rewards screen.

---

22. FREE AETHER REWARDS

Allow players to obtain small amounts of Aether through gameplay.

Initial reward structure:

- Daily quest: 5 Aether.
- Completing all daily quests: additional 10 Aether.
- Weekly quest: 25 Aether.
- First dungeon boss completion: 15 Aether.
- Special achievements: 20–100 Aether.
- Special events: 25–200 Aether.

Prevent duplicate reward claims.

Keep the premium economy balanced.

Do not award Aether through rewarded advertisements in the initial version.

---

23. REAL-MONEY SHOP

Create a complete premium shop.

The game is free to download.

Purchases are optional.

Shop categories:

- Aether packages.
- Gold packages.
- Equipment packages.
- Progression packages.
- Character skins.
- Weapon skins.
- Armor skins.
- Magical effects.
- VIP membership.

Initial Aether package proposals:

- 100 Aether: €0.99.
- 550 Aether: €4.99.
- 1,200 Aether: €9.99.
- 2,600 Aether: €19.99.
- 7,000 Aether: €49.99.
- 15,000 Aether: €99.99.

Use actual localized Google Play prices when available.

These are proposed prices, not hardcoded guaranteed transaction amounts.

---

24. PAID GAMEPLAY ADVANTAGES

Allow optional purchases that accelerate progression.

Examples:

- Experience boosters.
- Gold boosters.
- Equipment upgrade materials.
- Inventory expansions.
- Special equipment.
- Additional offline reward capacity.
- Premium cosmetic items.

Paid purchases may provide gameplay advantages.

However:

- Rank SSS must remain achievable without spending money.
- All classes must be obtainable through gameplay.
- Main dungeons must remain accessible without payment.
- Strong equipment must also be obtainable through gameplay.
- Avoid making free progression unnecessarily frustrating.

Do not create paid random loot boxes in the initial version.

---

25. VIP MEMBERSHIP

Create an optional monthly VIP subscription.

Proposed initial price: €4.99 per month.

VIP benefits:

- 20% additional gold.
- 20% additional experience.
- Daily VIP rewards.
- Exclusive VIP skin.
- Additional inventory space.
- Improved offline rewards.
- VIP membership indicator.

Display subscription terms, renewal details and cancellation information clearly.

VIP must never be required to complete the game.

---

26. REWARDED ADVERTISEMENTS

Implement optional rewarded advertisements using a supported advertising SDK such as Google AdMob.

Initial daily limit: 5 rewarded advertisements.

Possible rewards:

- Additional gold.
- Additional experience.
- Dungeon rewards.
- Equipment upgrade materials.
- Offline reward bonuses.

Advertisements must:

- Be optional.
- Never interrupt automatic combat.
- Never appear unexpectedly.
- Only award rewards after successful ad completion.
- Respect the daily limit.

Do not award Aether through advertisements in the initial version.

---

27. GOOGLE PLAY BILLING

Prepare official Android Google Play Billing integration for digital purchases.

Requirements:

- Retrieve real product information.
- Display localized prices.
- Support one-time purchases.
- Support recurring subscriptions.
- Verify transactions securely.
- Prevent duplicate rewards.
- Handle failed purchases.
- Handle cancelled purchases.
- Handle refunds and purchase reversals.
- Restore eligible purchases.
- Record purchase status.

Use secure server-side purchase verification where supported.

Never collect or store bank card details directly.

Never simulate successful real-money transactions.

If the development platform cannot implement native billing directly, prepare the interface and integration architecture for later Android implementation.

Clearly distinguish simulated development products from real purchases.

---

28. GAME INTERFACE

Create a premium professional dark fantasy anime mobile interface.

Main interface must include:

- Character model.
- Current Rank.
- Character level.
- Health bar.
- Experience bar.
- Gold balance.
- Aether balance.
- Active companion indicators.
- Current dungeon.
- Enemy health.
- Four manual skill buttons.

Create dedicated screens:

1. Character.
2. Attributes.
3. Equipment.
4. Inventory.
5. Skills.
6. Class.
7. Awakening.
8. Talent Tree.
9. Companions.
10. Shadow Collection.
11. Dungeons.
12. Shop.
13. Aether.
14. VIP.
15. Quests.
16. Achievements.

All important buttons must work.

Use responsive layouts and large touchscreen-friendly controls.

---

29. SAVE SYSTEM

Implement persistent game saving.

Save all important player data:

- Character level.
- Experience.
- Gold.
- Aether.
- Rank.
- Class.
- Class evolutions.
- Awakening stage.
- Attributes.
- Talents.
- Equipment.
- Inventory.
- Equipment upgrades.
- Companions.
- Shadow collection.
- Dungeon progress.
- Quests.
- Achievements.
- VIP status.
- Purchase history.
- Offline progression timestamp.

Player progress must remain saved after closing and reopening the application.

Use reliable data persistence.

Premium currency and real-money transactions must be protected against client-side manipulation.

---

30. PERFORMANCE AND ANDROID OPTIMIZATION

Optimize the game for Android smartphones.

Requirements:

- Smooth gameplay.
- Stable frame rate.
- Optimized 3D models.
- Efficient animations.
- Optimized textures.
- Controlled memory usage.
- Responsive touchscreen interface.
- Efficient save operations.
- Reliable application recovery after closing.

Avoid unnecessary graphical effects that damage performance.

---

31. DEVELOPMENT PRIORITIES

IMPORTANT: DO NOT ATTEMPT TO BUILD EVERY ADVANCED SYSTEM SIMULTANEOUSLY.

Build the game in stages while maintaining the complete architecture.

FIRST PLAYABLE VERSION:

Implement:

- One playable character.
- Realistic 3D anime graphics.
- Third-person camera.
- Automatic movement.
- Automatic basic combat.
- Four manual skill buttons.
- Forgotten Catacombs dungeon.
- Three enemy types.
- Skeleton King boss.
- Experience and character levels.
- Gold rewards.
- Basic inventory.
- Basic equipment drops.
- Rank F progression.
- Three initial companions.
- Persistent save system.
- Basic offline progression.

SECOND DEVELOPMENT STAGE:

Implement:

- Complete rank progression.
- Four classes.
- Class evolutions.
- Equipment rarities.
- Random item attributes.
- Equipment upgrading.
- Companion progression.
- Awakening system.
- Talent tree.

THIRD DEVELOPMENT STAGE:

Implement:

- Remaining dungeons.
- Additional bosses.
- Shadow summoning.
- Advanced equipment sets.
- Complete Aether economy.
- Premium shop.
- Google Play Billing integration.
- VIP membership.
- Rewarded advertisements.

FOURTH DEVELOPMENT STAGE:

Implement:

- Additional content.
- Special events.
- More companions.
- More equipment.
- Additional awakening stages.
- Advanced progression systems.
- Performance optimization.

---

32. FINAL DEVELOPMENT INSTRUCTIONS

The result must be an original and expandable Android idle RPG.

Prioritize actual working gameplay over decorative interfaces.

Do not create an open world.

Do not require manual movement.

Do not create multiplayer.

Do not copy existing copyrighted characters or assets.

Do not remove previously implemented systems when expanding the project.

Do not simulate real-money purchases.

Do not create buttons that have no functionality.

Do not create fake offline rewards.

If a feature cannot be implemented directly, clearly identify the missing technical integration and prepare a suitable extension point.

The first objective is a stable, functional and visually impressive playable prototype.

The long-term objective is to develop RANK UP: THE AWAKENING into a complete premium-quality 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG for Android.

Build the foundation carefully so every future system can be expanded without rebuilding the entire game.

END OF MASTER GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

"RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

MASTER GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT

Complete 3D Anime Dark Fantasy Idle RPG for Android

Create a completely new, original, high-quality 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG called:

RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

This is a single-player mobile RPG designed for Android.

The game combines autonomous combat, dungeon exploration, character progression, equipment collection, class evolution, companions, powerful bosses and a premium currency economy.

The game should have a visual identity inspired by high-quality realistic 3D dark fantasy anime, with cinematic character models, detailed environments, realistic lighting and spectacular combat effects.

Use modern dark fantasy anime games as visual inspiration, but create original characters, creatures, environments, names and storylines.

IMPORTANT:
Build an actual playable game, not just a collection of menus, concept art or static interfaces.

---

1. GAME IDENTITY

Game title: RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

Genre:

- Idle RPG.
- Dark fantasy.
- Dungeon crawler.
- Character progression.
- Automatic combat.
- Equipment collection.
- Companion collection.

Platform: Android mobile.

Gameplay perspective: Third person.

Game mode: Single-player.

The game must be designed primarily for touchscreen devices.

The player controls character development, equipment, abilities, classes, companions and dungeon selection.

The character fights and explores automatically.

There must be no requirement for manual joystick movement.

---

2. GRAPHICS AND ART DIRECTION

Create a premium realistic 3D anime visual style.

Visual requirements:

- Detailed human-like character models.
- Realistic anime faces and expressions.
- Detailed hairstyles.
- High-quality clothing and armor.
- Realistic materials and textures.
- Cinematic lighting.
- Dynamic shadows.
- Magical energy effects.
- Detailed monsters.
- Spectacular boss animations.
- Smooth combat animations.
- Atmospheric dungeon environments.

Visual inspiration:
Modern realistic 3D dark fantasy anime.

The game should feel like a premium anime action RPG.

Use dark environments with blue, cyan, purple, red and golden magical effects.

Optimize graphics for Android mobile devices without sacrificing visual quality unnecessarily.

---

3. STORY AND WORLD

Create an original fantasy universe.

The world is threatened by mysterious dimensional portals called Gates.

These Gates lead to dangerous dungeons inhabited by monsters, demons and ancient creatures.

Humans capable of fighting these creatures are known as Hunters.

Hunters are classified according to their power.

The player begins as an unknown and extremely weak Rank F Hunter.

Through dungeon exploration, combat, special missions and awakening events, the player gradually becomes one of the most powerful hunters in existence.

Create an original main storyline with:

- Hunter organizations.
- Mysterious Gates.
- Ancient civilizations.
- Powerful dungeon bosses.
- Secret missions.
- Special awakening events.
- Hidden legendary powers.

The story must be expandable through future updates.

---

4. IDLE GAMEPLAY AND AUTOMATIC COMBAT

The core gameplay must be an autonomous idle RPG.

The player character must:

- Move automatically through dungeon environments.
- Detect nearby enemies.
- Select targets automatically.
- Approach enemies.
- Attack automatically.
- Use basic combat animations.
- Select another enemy after defeating the current target.
- Collect rewards automatically.
- Progress through dungeon encounters.

Enemies must:

- Attack the player.
- Have individual health and damage.
- Use different attack patterns.
- Have unique animations.
- Become progressively stronger.

The player can die and respawn.

Create functional combat health bars and damage indicators.

The player must not need to manually control movement.

The player manually activates special abilities through touchscreen buttons.

---

5. MANUAL SKILL SYSTEM

Create four manually activated skill buttons.

Initial skills:

1. Powerful Strike.
2. Area Attack.
3. Healing.
4. Ultimate Ability.

Every skill must have:

- Unique animations.
- Visual effects.
- Damage or healing values.
- Cooldown timers.
- Upgrade levels.

Skills must be functional and responsive.

Add additional class-specific skills later.

---

6. CHARACTER PROGRESSION

Create a complete RPG character progression system.

Character attributes:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.

Combat statistics:

- Maximum Health.
- Attack Damage.
- Defense.
- Critical Chance.
- Critical Damage.
- Attack Speed.
- Movement Speed.
- Health Regeneration.
- Magical Damage.

The character must gain experience through:

- Defeating enemies.
- Completing dungeons.
- Defeating bosses.
- Completing quests.
- Achievements.

Include:

- Character levels.
- Experience bars.
- Attribute points.
- Skill points.
- Gold rewards.
- Character status screen.

Allow players to invest attribute points manually or use an optional automatic allocation system.

Create nine separate character ranks.

F
E
D
C
B
A
S
SS
SSS

Rank progression must require:

- Minimum character level.
- Special achievements.
- Rank examination missions.
- Powerful boss victories.
- Specific progression milestones.

Every rank must have:

- Unique emblem.
- Visual identity.
- Rank color.
- Rank progression screen.
- Unlockable rewards.
- Special requirements.

Rank progression must be separate from character class and equipment rarity.

A character can be:

- Warrior Rank S.
- Assassin Rank A.
- Mage Rank SSS.
- Necromancer Rank SS.

Do not combine rank and class into one progression system.

---

The player starts as an unclassified Hunter.

WARRIOR:

Combat style:
Heavy physical damage and defense.

Class evolutions:

- Knight.
- Paladin.
- Warrior King.

ASSASSIN:

Combat style:
Fast attacks, critical damage and agility.

Class evolutions:

- Shadow.
- Reaper.
- Shadow Lord.

Elemental magic and area damage.

Class evolutions:

- Sorcerer.
- Archmage.
- Arcane Master.

NECROMANCER:

Combat style:
Dark magic and undead summoning.

Class evolutions:

- Summoner.
- Master of the Dead.
- Undead Sovereign.

- Unique equipment.
- Unique abilities.
- Unique animations.
- Different attributes.
- Special class bonuses.
- Class-specific progression quests.

Allow switching between unlocked classes.

Class evolutions require levels, achievements and special missions.

---

Create five character awakening stages.

1. Dormant.
2. Awakened.
3. Evolved.
4. Transcendent.
5. Sovereign.

Each stage requires:

- Specific character level.
- Special awakening quest.
- Dungeon challenges.
- Powerful boss encounters.
- Awakening materials.

Each awakening stage must provide:

- Improved attributes.
- New abilities.
- Visual character transformation.
- Magical aura.
- Glowing eyes.
- Energy particles.
- Unique effects.

Create a special awakening animation.

Class-specific abilities:

WARRIOR:

- Absolute Fury.
- Titan's Defense.

ASSASSIN:

- Shadow Step.
- Phantom Execution.

MAGE:

- Arcane Storm.
- Elemental Overload.

NECROMANCER:

- Army of the Dead.
- Soul Harvest.

Create six talent branches.

- Attack.
- Defense.
- Agility.
- Magic.
- Summoning.
- Critical Damage.

Players earn talent points through character progression.

Every branch must contain multiple unlockable talents.

Talents must have meaningful gameplay effects.

Allow players to reset talents using an appropriate in-game resource.

---

11. DUNGEON SYSTEM

Do not create an open world.

Create three initial dungeons:

FORGOTTEN CATACOMBS:

- Skeleton Warriors.
- Undead Creatures.
- Skeleton King boss.

- Goblins.
- Cave Creatures.
- Goblin King boss.

DARK ABYSS:

- Demons.
- Shadow Creatures.
- Abyss Guardian boss.

Each dungeon must have:

- Multiple combat encounters.
- Increasing enemy difficulty.
- Unique environments.
- Boss encounters.
- Experience rewards.
- Gold rewards.
- Equipment drops.
- Special materials.

Defeating dungeon bosses unlocks new progression.

Include dungeon difficulty levels and replay functionality.

Start implementation with Forgotten Catacombs only.

Prepare the other dungeons for future expansion.

---

12. ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Create original monster designs.

Initial enemies:

- Skeleton Warrior.
- Goblin.
- Dark Creature.

Initial boss:

- Skeleton King.

Each enemy must have:

- Health.
- Damage.
- Defense.
- Attack animations.
- Experience rewards.
- Gold rewards.
- Equipment drop probabilities.

Bosses must have:

- Unique models.
- Special attacks.
- Multiple combat phases where appropriate.
- Boss health bars.
- Introductory animations.
- Exclusive loot tables.

Boss encounters should feel important and rewarding.

Create a complete equipment system.

Equipment slots:

1. Weapon.
2. Helmet.
3. Chest Armor.
4. Gloves.
5. Boots.

ASSASSIN:

- Daggers.
- Dual Blades.

MAGE:

- Magical Staffs.
- Wands.

NECROMANCER:

- Dark Staffs.
- Summoning Artifacts.

---

14. EQUIPMENT RARITIES

Create eight equipment rarity levels.

1. Common — Gray.
2. Uncommon — Green.
3. Rare — Blue.
4. Epic — Purple.
5. Legendary — Orange.
6. Mythic — Red.
7. Divine — Gold.
8. Transcendent — Cyan.

Each rarity must have:

- Different visual borders.
- Different effects.
- Different attribute ranges.
- Different drop probabilities.
- Different item descriptions.

Higher rarity equipment can have more attributes and unique abilities.

Equipment rarity must be independent of character rank.

---

15. RANDOM EQUIPMENT ATTRIBUTES

Generate randomized item statistics.

Possible attributes:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.
- Attack Damage.
- Critical Chance.
- Critical Damage.
- Attack Speed.
- Defense.
- Health Regeneration.
- Life Steal.
- Magical Damage.

Examples:

- Increased critical damage.
- Increased attack speed.
- Life steal.
- Increased magical damage.
- Summoning bonuses.
- Special combat abilities.

Every equipment drop must have a functional item description and statistics.

---

16. EQUIPMENT UPGRADING AND CRAFTING

Create an equipment upgrade system from +0 to +20.

Allow players to:

- Upgrade equipment.
- Use gold.
- Use upgrade materials.
- Craft equipment.
- Fuse duplicate items.
- Dismantle unwanted equipment.
- Compare items.

Create equipment sets.

Equipping multiple pieces from the same set activates bonuses.

Examples:

- Two-piece set bonus.
- Four-piece set bonus.
- Six-piece set bonus.

Create class-specific equipment sets.

Bosses should drop exclusive set pieces.

Companion categories:

- Warrior.
- Assassin.
- Guardian.
- Mage.
- Creature.

- Divine.
- Transcendent.

Start with three active companion slots.

Allow players to unlock up to five slots through gameplay progression.

Include:

- Companion collection.
- Companion selection.
- Companion leveling.
- Companion evolution.
- Companion equipment.
- Companion skills.

---

Create a special summoning system for Necromancers.

The Necromancer can convert eligible defeated enemies into shadow summons through special abilities and gameplay requirements.

Create:

- Shadow collection.
- Shadow levels.
- Shadow evolution.
- Shadow rarity.
- Shadow combat roles.
- Shadow upgrades.

Implement offline progression.

The game must continue calculating simulated rewards when the player closes the application.

Record the last logout timestamp.

When the player returns:

- Calculate elapsed time.
- Calculate simulated combat rewards.
- Award experience.
- Award gold.

- Display a summary of offline rewards.

Visual identity:

- Electric blue.
- Cyan.
- Translucent crystal.
- White glowing energy.
- Magical particles.
- Premium dark fantasy appearance.

Main premium currency.

## Objective
- Build a stable, playable prototype of **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING**, an original 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG for Android, or adapt the existing game to match the request.

## Requirements
- Prioritize autonomous dungeon combat, four manual skills, Forgotten Catacombs, three enemy types, Skeleton King, progression, drops, companions, persistent saving, and basic offline rewards.
- Use original content and touchscreen-friendly responsive UI; no open world, multiplayer, or manual movement requirement.
- Keep controls functional; do not simulate purchases or fake offline rewards. Clearly note unavailable technical integrations.
- Build now, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based prototype with canvas-rendered combat and responsive HTML/CSS UI; Android-native packaging and real 3D rendering remain unimplemented.
- Premium shop is informational only and explicitly states real purchases are not connected.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the main interface and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented game state and views for character, equipment, skills, companions, dungeons, quests, and shop in `game.js`.
- Added canvas scene rendering, combat loop, skill and keyboard/touch controls, event wiring, initialization, persistence, offline reward handling, equipment management, and companion activation in `game.js`.
- Ran `node --check game.js` before the latest implementation was added; it produced no output.

### Active
- Validate the latest `game.js` syntax and test the game in a browser, including combat, skills, navigation, progression, inventory, quests, saving, and offline rewards.
- Inspect the UI and fix runtime or visual issues; check that cooldown and other styles work as intended.
- Add usable run instructions, potentially in `README.md`.

### Blocked
- Browser launch and screenshot verification have not been completed.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` after the latest changes.
2. Launch and test the prototype; fix any issues found and capture/inspect a screenshot.
3. Add run instructions and summarize implemented features and unavailable integrations.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, content views, combat, rendering, controls, persistence, and initialization.
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD.
- `style.css`: Responsive dark-fantasy styling.
- `README.md`: Existing generic project README; may need run instructions.

## Important Context
- Local save key is `rank-up-awakening-save-v1`; offline rewards use a local timestamp and cap at 8 hours, without server-side integrity protection.
- Native Android packaging, billing, advertising, and true 3D rendering are not implemented.
- Changes are uncommitted; no repository commits have been made.

## Objective
- Build a stable, playable prototype of **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING**, an original 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG for Android, or adapt the existing game to match the request.

## Requirements
- Prioritize autonomous dungeon combat, four manual skills, Forgotten Catacombs, three enemy types, Skeleton King, progression, drops, companions, persistent saving, and basic offline rewards.
- Use original content and touchscreen-friendly responsive UI; no open world, multiplayer, or manual movement requirement.
- Keep controls functional; do not simulate purchases or fake offline rewards. Clearly note unavailable technical integrations.
- Build now, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based prototype with canvas-rendered combat and responsive HTML/CSS UI; Android-native packaging and real 3D rendering remain unimplemented.
- Premium shop is informational only and explicitly states real purchases are not connected.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the main interface and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented game state, views for character/equipment/skills/companions/dungeons/quests/shop, canvas combat scene, controls, progression, persistence, offline rewards, loot, and initialization in `game.js`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`.
- Served the prototype locally and captured a desktop browser screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/rank-up.png`.

### Active
- Inspect browser output and test interactions/navigation/combat for runtime or visual issues.
- Add usable run instructions, potentially in `README.md`.

### Blocked
- No known blockers; interactive browser testing and visual inspection remain incomplete.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/rank-up.png` and test the prototype in a browser, including skills, navigation, progression, inventory, quests, saving, and offline rewards.
2. Fix issues found and rerun `node --check game.js`.
3. Add run instructions and summarize implemented features and unavailable integrations.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, content views, combat, rendering, controls, persistence, and initialization.
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD.
- `style.css`: Responsive dark-fantasy styling.
- `README.md`: Existing generic project README; may need run instructions.
- `/tmp/opencode/rank-up.png`: Captured desktop browser screenshot for visual inspection.

## Important Context
- Local save key is `rank-up-awakening-save-v1`; offline rewards use a local timestamp and cap at 8 hours, without server-side integrity protection.
- Native Android packaging, billing, advertising, and true 3D rendering are not implemented.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed untracked `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css`.

## Objective
- Build a stable, playable prototype of **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING**, an original 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG for Android, or adapt the existing game to match the request.

## Requirements
- Prioritize autonomous dungeon combat, four manual skills, Forgotten Catacombs, three enemy types, Skeleton King, progression, drops, companions, persistent saving, and basic offline rewards.
- Use original content and touchscreen-friendly responsive UI; no open world, multiplayer, or manual movement requirement.
- Keep controls functional; do not simulate purchases or fake offline rewards. Clearly note unavailable technical integrations.
- Build now, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based prototype with canvas-rendered combat and responsive HTML/CSS UI; Android-native packaging and real 3D rendering remain unimplemented.
- Premium shop is informational only and explicitly states real purchases are not connected.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the main interface and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented game state, views for character/equipment/skills/companions/dungeons/quests/shop, canvas combat, controls, progression, persistence, offline rewards, loot, and initialization in `game.js`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`.
- Captured and inspected a desktop screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/rank-up.png`.
- Browser-tested navigation across all views, a combat skill, auto toggle, equipment, companion toggle, shop messaging, and mobile layout; no JavaScript page errors observed.

### Active
- Investigate the browser console’s one 404 resource error.
- Test save restoration and offline rewards; add run instructions to `README.md`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Identify and resolve the browser’s 404 resource request.
2. Test persistence and offline reward behavior, including the 8-hour cap.
3. Add local run instructions to `README.md`, then rerun `node --check game.js` and summarize implementation and unavailable integrations.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, combat, views, persistence, offline rewards, and initialization.
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD.
- `style.css`: Responsive dark-fantasy styling.
- `README.md`: Existing project README; needs run instructions.
- `/tmp/opencode/rank-up.png`: Captured desktop screenshot.

## Important Context
- Local save key is `rank-up-awakening-save-v1`; offline rewards use a local timestamp, cap at 8 hours, and have no server-side integrity protection.
- Native Android packaging, billing, advertising, and true 3D rendering are not implemented.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed untracked `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css`.
